Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: They misinterpreted a methodological ScienceDirect article on variance/standard deviation as a source for domain-level Reference Works counts, clicking into an irrelevant page. By Rule 2, this is a misuse/misread of what data source was needed, which then contributed to the later looping and access issues (Rule 1). After this diversion, the search path focused on the wrong content, making effective recovery within the constraints increasingly difficult (Rule 3).
